component.name: Python Lair 2
component.summary: Lightweight Python IDE and script launcher for Linux

description.p: Python Lair 2 is a lightweight workspace for discovering, editing, organizing and launching standalone Python scripts.
It includes folder dashboards, an embedded editor, process controls, direct folder imports, drag-and-drop organization, and asynchronous scanning for large libraries.
Publication and source-packaging update adding the locked root README.md.
